Training Arena.Description: This secluded, abandoned foundry is Dr. Bastard's lair. If you survive what this madman's got in store for you, you'll come out this Arena a Zombie Fighter.

City Crossroad.Description: Dr. Bastard built this arena at the center of a five lane crossroad, at the heart of a once great city.

Maya Ruin.Description: A pit dug in the middle of an ancient Mayan Ruin. Ideal for human sacrifices.
